title: Adjournment motion with speeches on community participation and government partnerships
what_it_is: An adjournment motion moved by the Deputy Leader of the House, followed by speeches from Mr Foo Cexiang and Ms Goh Hanyan on community participation and government partnerships.
why_it_matters: For residents in the estates mentioned, the transcript describes local pilots: blue recycling bins removed in Seng Poh estate with collection drives, a participatory budgeting pilot in Spottiswoode Park with a $200,000 budget, and a digital art exhibition at the Tiong Bahru Air Raid Shelter. It also lists government funds and programmes intended to support citizen-led initiatives, such as the $50 million SG Partnerships Fund and expanded Heritage Activation Nodes. The record does not state any nationwide change in law or policy.

key_points.point: The Deputy Leader of the House moved that Parliament adjourn.
key_points.speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said the democracy of deeds was manifest in three ways: residents acting to solve problems, creating shared spaces, and reaching consensus through dialogue.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: we have observed the democracy of deeds manifest in three ways.

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said the "Bye Bye Blue Bins" pilot in Seng Poh estate removed the blue bins for three weeks and held two recycling collection drives.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: We have removed the bins for three weeks and have conducted two recycling collection drives.

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said the second recycling collection drive drew more than 100 households with about 600 kilogrammes of recyclables.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: For the second event, we had more than 100 households turn up with about 600 kilogrammes of recyclables.

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said a digital art exhibition at the Tiong Bahru Air Raid Shelter ran for a week from 19 to 26 January this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: His exhibition ran for a week from 19 to 26 January this year

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said the participatory budgeting pilot in Spottiswoode Park set aside a budget of $200,000 for residents to develop and pitch ideas for their neighbourhood.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: We set aside a budget of $200,000; residents develop and pitch ideas on enhancements for their neighbourhood.

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said the ideas from the participatory budgeting pilot will be put to a feasibility committee before an exhibition and voting.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: Then, the ideas will be put to a feasibility committee made up of the technical agencies before we proceed with an exhibition and voting.

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang recommended that for state properties, the Government choose proposals based on potential social impact instead of rental bid.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: Instead of selecting a proposal based on rental bid, the Government chooses proposals based on the proposal's potential social impact.

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said he hoped HDB would consider enhancing the Neighbourhood Renewal Programme to include a participatory budgeting segment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: I hope HDB can consider enhancing NRP to also include a segment for PB

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said a localised recycling approach may be much more effective in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: a localised recycling approach may be much more effective in Singapore.

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said MCCY should lead the whole-of-Government charge in three key areas: ambition, coordination and skills.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
key_points.quote: we need MCCY to lead the whole-of-Government charge in three key areas.

key_points.point: Ms Goh Hanyan said the Government is leaning into a shift from government for the people to government with the people across three fronts.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
key_points.quote: This shift – from government for the people, to the government with the people – is something we are actively leaning into, across three fronts

key_points.point: Ms Goh Hanyan said MCCY, the Ministry of National Development and HDB are piloting different ways to deepen engagement as part of the Neighbourhood Renewal Programme in Boon Lay and Canberra.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
key_points.quote: MCCY, Ministry of National Development and HDB are piloting different ways to deepen this engagement as part of NRP in Boon Lay and Canberra.

key_points.point: Ms Goh Hanyan said MSE is partnering Zero Waste SG's trial of dedicated recycling bins for clean stream recyclables in Pioneer.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
key_points.quote: MSE is partnering Zero Waste SG's trial of dedicated recycling bins for clean stream recyclables in Pioneer.

key_points.point: Ms Goh Hanyan said SLA will continue to engage social startups and non-government organisations and work with agencies to unlock more state properties with social impact.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
key_points.quote: SLA will continue to engage social startups and non-government organisations to understand their needs, and work with agencies to unlock more state properties with social impact.

key_points.point: Ms Goh Hanyan said the next run of Youth Panels will launch later this year.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
key_points.quote: We will launch the next run of Youth Panels later this year for more youths to step forward and contribute.

key_points.point: Ms Goh Hanyan said Heritage Activation Nodes will be expanded to more neighbourhoods this year, including Tiong Bahru and Telok Blangah.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
key_points.quote: We will be expanding these nodes to more neighbourhoods this year, including Tiong Bahru and Telok Blangah.

key_points.point: Ms Goh Hanyan said the $50 million SG Partnerships Fund was launched this year to support citizens and ground-ups from starting up to scaling up.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
key_points.quote: we launched the $50 million SG Partnerships Fund this year to support citizens and ground-ups at any stage – from starting up to scaling up.

key_points.point: The Speaker informed Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 11.00 am.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 11.00 am.

what_happens_next: The Speaker informed that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 11.00 am, and Parliament adjourned at 9.30 pm. For the Spottiswoode Park participatory budgeting pilot, ideas will go to a feasibility committee before an exhibition and voting. Ms Goh Hanyan said the next run of Youth Panels will launch later this year, Heritage Activation Nodes will expand this year including Tiong Bahru and Telok Blangah, and the Somerset Belt Youth CoLab team is planning Youth Month in July.
not_said: Whether the "Bye Bye Blue Bins" pilot in Seng Poh estate will be extended beyond the three weeks or made permanent.
Whether the participatory budgeting pilot in Spottiswoode Park will be adopted in other estates or incorporated into the Neighbourhood Renewal Programme.
Whether the proposed alternative model for allocating state properties based on social impact will be implemented, and what criteria would be used.
Whether MCCY will take on the whole-of-Government coordination role proposed by Mr Foo Cexiang.
How the outcomes of the various pilots, funds and programmes will be evaluated or reported.
What the timeline and budget are for expanding Heritage Activation Nodes to more neighbourhoods.
Whether any legislative or policy changes will follow from the debate.
